routines.tolerance: Live comparator remains1e-12 absolute-or-relative for physical time endpoints. Opaque subnormal/NaN word values are never used as numeric evidence: all six signed-int32 fields are exposed as integer numbers, where a one-bit integer difference exceeds tolerance throughout the int32 range. Independent exact40byte comparisons verify preserved payload and literal all-eight-field comparisons verify unpacking. No global tolerance relaxation.

findings.summary: Floating absolute/relative tolerance can equate distinct embedded integer bit patterns; old unpack case ignored the actual pack output. Valid negative-center descriptor NaN words were rejected by the Node adapter, and native Number construction/worker structured clone could canonicalize the payload.
findings.repair: Keep exact byte copies behind the unchanged public readonly five-number tuple. Private N-API uses typed packed buffers in both directions; WASM copies bytes into/out of its heap. The existing extensible RPC codec has a descriptor-specific typed tag. Both harnesses compare time bounds plus all six extracted signed integer fields and can retain actual packed output for later actual unpack. Literal all-eight-field assertions and a controlled one-bit defect establish assertion sensitivity. Ordinary numerical arrays retain their existing RPC representation.
